summary: Computes a 4x4 world transform for a scene node. Optionally applies Euler-angle sign adjustments from a caller-supplied vector under flag bits 0x2000/0x100, rebuilds the rotation matrix from stored Euler angles when the dirty bit 0x20 is set, fills a selected 3x4 rotation-plus-translation buffer (scratch stack, alternate, or primary), sets the computed bit 0x40, updates the transform through TransformationMatrixUpdate, copies the primary matrix to a second slot, and clears dirty bits in a caller object. Returns 0 when the matrix was already computed, otherwise 1.

operations.description: If the transform flags at this+60 (field 0x3C) have bits 0x2100 set, clear them via BitmaskClear(this, 64, 0, 0).
If the computed bit 0x40 is already set in the transform flags (field 0x3C), return 0 immediately.
When the optional Euler vector a2 is present and flag 0x2000 is set, write PI minus a2[13] into the Y rotation angle field 0x30.
Else, when flag 0x100 is set, also write the negated a2[12] and a2[14] into the X rotation angle field 0x2C and Z rotation angle field 0x34 respectively.

If the needs-rebuild bit 0x20 is set in the flags (field 0x3C), clear that bit, rebuild the rotation matrix at this+108 from the Euler-angle fields 0x60/0x64/0x68 via EulerAngleToRotationMatrix, then propagate source fields 0x54/0x58/0x5C through MultiFieldSetter.

Select the output buffer: stack scratch when the low bit of the flags byte is set; otherwise the alternate buffer when the parent/alternate pointer field 0x40 is non-null; otherwise the primary buffer.

Compute sin/cos of the Euler angles at fields 0x2C/0x30/0x34 and fill the three rotation rows of the selected buffer; write the translation column from fields 0x20/0x24/0x28 and the constant 1065353216 as the homogeneous component. The matrix element computation reads the shared constant at global flt_59E660.
Set the computed bit 0x40 in the transform flags at field 0x3C.
Update the transformation matrix through TransformationMatrixUpdate(0).
Copy the first half of the computed 4x4 matrix (output-matrix fields 0x114..0x130) into the second matrix slot starting at field 0x154.
Copy the second half of the computed 4x4 matrix (output-matrix fields 0x134..0x150) into the second matrix slot starting at field 0x154.
When the caller object a3 is present, clear its dirty bits: *(a3 + 20) &= 0xDFFFFFD7.
Return 1 to signal a freshly computed transform.
